title: Counting a Prior Carrier's Approved Quantity in the Strength Now Filled at Retail
content:
On a continuity-of-care quantity limit authorization under the Utilization Management Program, the prior carrier's quantity is counted in tablets of the strength the member now fills at Northbridge Rx retail by multiplying it by a strength ratio:

| Strength on the prior carrier's approval on file | Strength of the member's most recent paid retail fill of the drug | Ratio |
|---|---|---|
| 50 mg tablet | 100 mg tablet | 0.5 |
| 100 mg tablet | 50 mg tablet | 2 |
| any other combination, including the same strength | | 1 |

The strength on the approval is the strength recorded on the member's case relying on the prior carrier's approval. The retail fill is the most recent paid retail claim for the drug under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit, read by its date of service.

## Hypothetical cases

- A prior carrier's approval for 12 tablets of the 50 mg tablet, with the member now filling the 100 mg tablet at retail: 12 multiplied by 0.5 counts as 6 tablets.
- An approval for 6 tablets of the 100 mg tablet, with the member now filling the 50 mg tablet: 6 multiplied by 2 counts as 12 tablets.
- An approval for 9 tablets of the 100 mg tablet, with the member still filling the 100 mg tablet: the ratio is 1 and 9 tablets count.
- An approval written for a strength other than the 50 mg or 100 mg tablet: the ratio is 1.
